body.name: \(\theta_\pi^{ab}\)
body.construction: For a fixed \(\pi\ne\pi_0\), choose \(u,v\in V\) with \(u\) preceding \(v\) under \(\pi_0\) and \(v\) preceding \(u\) under \(\pi\). Choose \(\beta\ne0\) and distinct \(r_u,r_v\in(-1,1)\). Set the only nonzero structural coefficient to \(B^{(a)}[v,u]=B^{(b)}[v,u]=\beta\), with every coefficient in the other views zero. Set every within-view disturbance variance to one, set \(\Gamma_u[a,b]=r_u\), \(\Gamma_v[a,b]=r_v\), complete these two matrices by symmetry and zero off-pair entries, and set \(\Gamma_i=I_m\) for every other coordinate. Call the resulting parameter \(\theta_\pi^{ab}\).
